title: What Lifts Each Hold Reason on a Wayfare Driver Agreement
content:
A hold on a **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** agreement is recorded with one hold reason, and each reason is lifted by its own requirement. The mapping is identical on the Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green, Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare XL, Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV levels.

| Hold reason | What lifts it (every level) |
|---|---|
| Expired document | an unexpired replacement document on file |
| Safety investigation | the investigation cleared by Trust and Safety |
| Background recheck pending | a clear recheck result |
| Identity check failed | identity confirmed by a new photo check |
| Cancellation rate | the hold days elapsed |

A hold reason is lifted only by the requirement on its own row; meeting the requirement of another row does not lift it. For example, on a hypothetical agreement on hold for a pending background recheck, a newly uploaded insurance document does not lift the hold; a clear recheck result does.
